en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a canal or harbor lined with sailing ships and buildings on both sides. Visible cobblestone street runs alongside the waterway. Leafless trees and a bridge are visible in the background, and a prominent church steeple or tower is faintly visible in the far distance. There is handwritten cursive text in what appears to be Swedish or a closely related language at the bottom of the image.
